_source: SFWF Website Copy Deck v1.0, section 4. Copy verbatim.

hero.h1: Increasing the accessibility of our programs and the diversity of our community
hero.intro: Our scholarship program extends the Foundation’s training to farmers, land stewards, and community leaders who couldn’t otherwise afford it, with priority for applicants working in under-resourced regions where restored soil changes lives fastest.

stories.h2: What a seat in the classroom becomes
stories.note: Two to three scholarship recipient stories: photo, name, country, one paragraph each. Doubles as donor-facing proof.
stories.awaiting: The first scholars are partway through their programs. We will publish their stories here when they are ready to tell them, in their own words rather than ours.

steps.title: Tell us about you
steps.body: A short application: where you are, what you steward, and what you would do with the training.

steps.title: We review in cohorts
steps.body: Applications are read in batches rather than one at a time, so everyone in a round is compared fairly.
steps.note: Confirm the review cadence and the criteria with the education team, then replace this sentence with the real ones. How often is a round read, and what is weighed? Evan.

steps.title: Start learning
steps.body: Scholars join the same courses, the same community and the same guarantee as every other student.

donorPanel.title: Fund a scholarship
donorPanel.body: Every seat you sponsor puts a trained Soil Regenerator in a community that needs one. Scholarship-designated gifts go directly to student access.
